column1: # The bonus a trophy grants, as the 実績 screen prints it -- the ★ or ● tail on
# the right of every row. Hand-written; this is the file to edit.
# Columns: the Japanese <TAB> the English.
# The Japanese is the tail of a trophy Id in archives/Rance10EX_v1_04/40_実績情報.x,
# marker and all, exactly as it appears there. Thirteen of them cover the
# fifty-seven rows that have one, which is why they live here rather than being
# written out per row in glossaries/trophy_name_glossary.tsv.
# NOT the ボーナス column of that table. That one looks like the same words and
# is not text at all: CompletedTrophy@CalcStatus and ClearPoint::get run
# String.Contains over it for ＣＰ, 物理倍率, 魔法倍率, 異常レジスト,
# 自動戦闘倍率 and 割り込み発動, and every achievement bonus in the game is
# decided by that. Translating it silently switches them all off. It stays
# Japanese; this is the part that is only ever drawn.
# The tail column is what is left of a row after the name: ten full-width
# characters, which is what the widest Japanese tail uses. modules/TrophyNames.js
# measures, and docs/trophy-names.md has the layout.
